name: Griffith Observatory
note: The white body on Mount Hollywood's south shoulder with its planetarium dome rising to 36 m and a telescope dome at each end of the front that faces the lawn.
source: OpenStreetMap way 422130705 'Griffith Observatory', man_made=observatory, height 35.9; its three domes are ways 1360680899, 1360680900 and 1360680901 (roof:shape=dome), radii 5.1, 5.1 and 12.9 m

name: Capitol Records Building
note: The round tower north of Hollywood and Vine at its 47 m, a sunshade ringing each of its floors, and its spire.
source: OpenStreetMap way 422141102 'Capitol Records Building', height 46.8, building:levels 13 (blocks/labels.json); the round plan is its USA Structures outline

name: Hollywood Bowl
note: The shell at the low end of the bowl, a quarter-sphere 30 m across opening south-west toward the seats.
source: OpenStreetMap way 427527131, height 24.2, inside the Hollywood Bowl's amenity=theatre area (way 133701914), with its ring parts 297126803 to 297126808

name: Hollywood Bowl seating
note: The seats are the hillside, rising 45 m from the shell: the survey's slope is kept, not levelled into one floor.
source: USA Structures footprint 10116115, 7,604 m2, under OpenStreetMap's Hollywood Bowl area; the lidar falls from 215 m at its back to 170 m at the shell

name: Pacific Theatres Cinerama Dome
note: The geodesic dome on Sunset Boulevard, 38 m across and 21 m high.
source: OpenStreetMap way 423247168 'Pacific Theatres Cinerama Dome', roof:shape=dome, height 21 (blocks/labels.json)
